description: This Java source file defines the class 'FindServices' which provides a collection of static utility methods for constructing, executing, and managing complex database entity queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for preparing query parameters, creating entity conditions, executing searches with pagination, and handling date-based filters, primarily aimed at facilitating flexible and dynamic data retrieval processes.

classes.name: FindServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing, executing, and managing entity-based database queries in OFBiz.

methods.name: prepareField
methods.description: Analyzes input parameters with special suffixes to produce a normalized map of fields and operators for building dynamic queries.

methods.name: createConditionList
methods.description: Creates a list of entity conditions from input parameters and model fields, supporting grouping logic.

methods.name: createSingleCondition
methods.description: Generates a single entity condition based on a model field, operation, value, and context.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Builds a list of entity conditions from a normalized fields map and model entity, accounting for multiple conditions per field.

methods.name: performFindList
methods.description: Executes a find operation and returns paginated results as a list with total size.

methods.name: performFind
methods.description: Performs a dynamic find operation returning an iterator, with optional grouping and ordering.

methods.name: prepareFind
methods.description: Prepares the conditions and query parameters for a find operation, including date filters.

methods.name: executeFind
methods.description: Executes the prepared entity query and returns an iterator along with total result size.

methods.name: buildReducedQueryString
methods.description: Creates a simplified query string map from input fields, removing extraneous suffix-based keys.

methods.name: performFindItem
methods.description: Executes a find operation and returns only the first matched entity as a single item.
